title: State Variation Note: Premium Tax Recovery on Full Surrender of Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Compliance note on state premium tax for full surrenders of Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts.

## Rule

On a full surrender of a contract issued in one of the premium tax states — **CA** (California) — Ashgrove recovers the state premium tax on the premiums received: at **0.5% (0.005)** of those premiums on an IRA contract and at **2.35% (0.0235)** of those premiums on a non-qualified contract, rounded to the cent. A contract issued in any other state bears no premium tax recovery. The recovery is taken out of the cash surrender value.

## Records read

- The state of issue on the contract record.
- The tax registration on the contract record: a traditional IRA, Roth IRA or SEP IRA is an IRA contract; otherwise the contract is non-qualified.
- The premiums received: the total of the premium receipt entries in the contract's activity history.

## Matrix

| State of issue | Tax registration | Recovery |
|---|---|---|
| CA | Traditional IRA, Roth IRA or SEP IRA | 0.5% of premiums received |
| CA | Non-qualified | 2.35% of premiums received |
| Any other state | Any | None |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, premiums received $100000.00)

- Issued in CA, non-qualified: $2350.00 recovered.
- Issued in CA, Roth IRA: $500.00 recovered.
- Issued in NY, non-qualified: nothing recovered.
- Issued in CA, non-qualified, premiums received $43210.55: 2.35% gives $1015.447925, recovered as $1015.45.
